decision_statement: Both proposed lanes failed material assigned screens. Lane P missed its frozen IAS15 physical threshold and callback-accounting integrity gate; Lane T missed carrier-consistency and tangent/MEGNO continuity gates.

historical_results_preserved.manifest_18_scope: Historical combined standard-kernel WHFast physical+tangent/continuous-MEGNO configuration only.

reference_handling.timestamps: 101 exact stored samples at 100-year cadence; no interpolation or resampling

scope: Architecture screen only; no production qualification or Stage 4 authorization.
smallest_successor_action: Stop and perform a separately preregistered source-only and offline audit of the shared diagnostic-copy/synchronization representation against the frozen IAS15 state rows. This requires no new scientific integration and must resolve the order-17 copy callback accounting and coordinate-direction estimator floor before any architecture retest.

tangent_lane_reuse.historical_role: One-factor synchronization control only; never treated as an identical-contract reuse.
tangent_lane_reuse.reason: Historical lane used safe_mode=1 and keep_unsynchronized=0; the preregistered Lane T uses safe_mode=0 and keep_unsynchronized=1. These are material effective settings, so the prefix is not contract-identical.

all_physical_pairs.basis: Ten times Manifest 16's frozen IAS15 nonphase/orientation scales, while retaining Manifest 10's Mercury-rate threshold.

lane_p_vs_ias15.basis: Ten times the qualified componentwise IAS15 phase envelope, with the historical 5e-10 per-body pointwise floor. This is a screen threshold, not a production threshold.

lane_t_carrier_vs_ias15_and_lane_p.basis: The frozen 0.5-day versus 0.25-day 10-kyr WHFast discrepancy scale from Manifest 16; raw Cartesian phase is not the sole veto.

tangent_sync_control.basis: Frozen Manifest 10 tangent/MEGNO/LCN gates; the direction RMS is the discrepancy implied by cosine 0.9999 and log-norm is a scale-free screen-only extension.
tangent_sync_control.physical_per_body_rule: max(10*IAS15 per-body envelope, 0.1*historical old-tangent-vs-IAS15 per-body RMS)

unresolved_metric_policy.essential_metrics: Physical scaled state, coordinate-free/nonsingular histories, conservation, Lane T tangent/MEGNO/LCN continuity, carrier consistency, integrity, and restart closure.
unresolved_metric_policy.secular_frequency_and_absolute_perihelio: Known before integration to be resolution-limited at 10 kyr and 100-year cadence; report estimates and uncertainty but treat them as contextual, nonessential metrics.
